name: UltraGreek Style Effects
author: Hammer

sections.description: Free style presets for WordPress content with shortcodes, Gutenberg block, and classic editor button. Enable the looks you want from the admin panel and embed them with shortcodes or the block. No license key is required in this free build. The Premium tab contains informational content only.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ultragreek-style-effects folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to “UltraGreek Style Effects” in the admin menu and enable the styles you want.
  4. Add a shortcode in your content, e.g. [white]Your text here[/white], or use the “UltraGreek Style Effects” block in the block editor.
sections.faq:
Does this free build need a license key?

No. This free version works without any license or activation requirement.

How do split styles work?

Place the content inside the shortcode and leave a blank line between paragraphs to render separate cards.
